The main takeaway from our work is that
the buffer layer is a key parameter in determining the pinch-off characteristics and output conductance of pseudomorphic HEMTs.
a thin undoped high purity buffer layer (3000Å, 550° C) grown prior to the active layer provides sharp pinch-off characteristics and low leakage currents.
the buffer layer is a key element in pseudomorphic high electron transistors and its properties can be optimized by varying growth conditions.
